name: toast
title: Toast
description: Snackbar notifications from an imperative toast() call, with actions, a queue and swipe to dismiss.
improvements: Content is a React node, never HTML, fixing the XSS in Materialize's html option (CVE-2019-11004).
Announced through persistent aria-live regions (assertive for errors).
Timers pause on hover, focus and when the window loses focus.
Swipe to dismiss uses Pointer Events; no global listeners leak after a toast closes.
A queue limits how many toasts are visible at once.
